_source: measured 2026-10-12 census (code lines: non-blank, non-comment), same method as the 2026-09-14 census, extended to the projects built since

_source_detail.measured: 2026-10-12, working trees as they stood that day (Atlas: the main checkout, on branch next, 4 commits ahead of the last production push)
_source_detail.method: The 2026-09-14 census script (loc.js) re-run unchanged except one more kept directory (~/.claude/mods). Repo files come from git ls-files -co --exclude-standard, so .gitignore'd output is skipped; non-git folders are walked. Each code file is split into code / comment / blank lines with per-language comment rules; only code lines are counted. Exact copies (sha1) and near-identical copies (line-set Jaccard >= 0.7) are counted once, under the most recently active project; a project that is 80%+ copies of another is not counted. Repos owned by a collaborator count only the lines git blame gives to Owen.
_source_detail.exclusions: node_modules, venvs and every package/cache/build-output directory (dist, build, out, release, coverage, .next and the rest); vendored and third-party code (vendor dirs, license-banner files such as bundled marked/purify); minified, bundled, hashed and .d.ts files; generated Prisma migrations; saved web pages; lockfiles, JSON, CSV and other data files (not code extensions); Markdown (counted separately, not included); git worktrees, second clones, deploy copies (mantle-live, news-shadow-deploy, portfolio-site-live, the packaged Quartz build), backups, scratch folders and Claude background-job copies; the frozen _explore/i2 snapshot of this site; skills synced from claude.ai; class notes; and work that is not Owen's (the Tensor extensions, MultiMC, overworld_music_pack, a third-party fly-brain reference model).
_source_detail.tool: loc.js (node, no external counter). Raw lines including blanks and comments: 1,194,235; comment lines 227,609; blank lines 91,084.
_source_detail.previous: The 2026-09-14 census gave 408,364 code lines in 1,355 files. The growth is mostly new projects (Mantle, Helm, Arkhe, the fly-brain simulation, this site) plus Quartz and the portal growing.
_source_detail.rounding: Every figure is a whole-line count; display strings round to one decimal place in thousands.

residuals.by_project_unattributed_note: The 14 named groups account for 839,291 of 875,541 lines. The remaining 36,250 sit in 17 smaller projects and tools not broken out individually. Label any leftover slice "everything else", never zero it.
residuals.by_language_unattributed_note: The 7 named languages account for 873,733 lines; the remaining 1,808 are other languages (SQL, Prisma, shell, batch and others). JSX is folded into JavaScript and TSX into TypeScript.

conflicts_with_other_measurements.subject: Browser
conflicts_with_other_measurements.other_measurement_says: 63,029 JavaScript lines + 13,218 CSS lines = 76,247 (CONTENT-UPDATE.md §1, `git ls-files | xargs wc -l`) [measured 16 Sep, not re-run]
conflicts_with_other_measurements.why: Different rules. The census counts CODE lines; `wc -l` counts every line including blanks and comments, and `git ls-files` sweeps a different file set. Neither figure is wrong; they are not interchangeable. Do not add them together or present them side by side without saying which rule each used.
